correctness.rationale: Reconstructed definitions and proof for all N≥2, nonempty proper occupied sets A,B, and every fixed 1≤m≤N under uniform m-subset sampling without replacement. q_t(m)=C(N−t,m)/C(N,m) with zero beyond support; inclusion–exclusion gives C_m=q_(r+s−a)(m)−q_r(m)q_s(m). Nested sets have nonnegative C_m by I_A≤I_B. For nonnested sets, at m=N−(r+s−a)+1 joint miss is impossible while both marginal misses have positive probability, so covariance is strictly negative. On positive joint-miss support the successive-m ratio R_m=q_u/(q_r q_s) starts at R_0=1 and has multiplier minus 1 equal to [a(N−m)−rs]/[(N−r−m)(N−s−m)]; the numerator decreases in m, so a positive-sign segment can only precede a negative segment. C_1=(Na−rs)/N² gives strict two-sign iff nonnested and Na>rs. The bound Na>rs≥(a+1)² enforces N≥5; the complete N=5 arithmetic leaves precisely (2,2,1) and (3,3,2). For r=s=2,a=1 the exact polynomial x(x−1)(N−x)((N−2)x−2(N−1))/[N²(N−1)²(N−2)], x=N−m, gives positive m≤N−3, negative m=N−2, zeros at N−1,N. Independent shortest-subset exhaustive enumeration verified 3,774 rational covariance instances across 460 feasible parameter triples for N=2..10 and the full sign criterion, plus 5,040 exact special-family polynomial/sign comparisons for N=5..100. Source verification script and certificate were inspected; the unrestricted conclusion relies on analytic proof, not finite checks or certificate labels.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration does not cover arbitrary N; analytic ratio-factor proof supplies that quantifier.
No result for nonuniform site inclusion, sampling with replacement, imperfect detection, or biological cause of covariance.

value.rationale: For fixed species-by-site incidence matrices, covariance of the two natural random pooled-detection indicators is a meaningful survey-scale dependence invariant, distinct from static site-level co-occurrence. The theorem gives an exact complete sign-order classification, a nonnested-plus-overlap iff criterion, the smallest population permitting reversal and both extremal five-site shapes, and a family with reversals arbitrarily late. These are motivated structural facts applicable whenever rarefaction changes pooled survey depth; not merely a relabeling of C_1 or a finite table. No general ecological causal interpretation or nonuniform-design extension is claimed.
residual_risks: Usefulness is mathematical/measurement-theoretic; it does not establish actual positive or negative ecological interaction.
Absolute priority and impact depend on historical literature, which cannot be exhaustively excluded.
